description: List every call-site that references a UID / service / controller / handler (or `ref#method`) in the project's own code (src/, config/ and database/migrations; node_modules and build output are not searched) — a UID passed through a `const` counts at the call, a UID written as a plain value (a registry map, a config entry) counts as `[literal]`, a migration in a subfolder (never run) is marked archived. Returns the total first, then a page of references; `unresolvedCalls` lists the Strapi calls whose UID DevKit cannot read that may reach it too. Compact by default (`path:line:col [via]  snippet`, 1-based) — pass `compact: false` for full objects. Pass `refs` to query several at once. See coverage for the call forms indexed.

compact.description: Compact one-line-per-hit output (default true). false → full objects.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

ref.description: A Strapi reference: a content-type or component UID (api::article.article, shared.seo), a service / controller / policy / middleware ref (api::article.article, plugin::users-permissions.user, global::is-owner), or a route handler (api::article.article.find). `ref#method` targets one method.

refs.description: Several refs to query in one call (batch).

name: find_references
title: Find references to a Strapi entity
